_about: Mood vocabulary v2 (CJ, 2026-09-19), checked against GEMS-9, the MIREX mood clusters, Epidemic Sound's moods, MTG-Jamendo's mood tags, and the YM2413-MDB game-music tags. From v1: tense splits into suspenseful, ominous and intense; mournful folds into sad; powerful becomes epic; hopeful, laid-back and dreamy are new. The glosses steer the model and never reach the app. Not active until moods.json is switched to it.

fierce and urgent, a fight, a boss battle
unsettling, haunted, creepy, not quite right

uplifting, rising, light after the dark

hazy, floating, ethereal
